counting_convention: ORDERED pairs (P, Q) in F x F with P + Q = R; the total over all targets is therefore B^2
index_convention: target index i means [i]G for the recorded generator; index 0 is the identity O

matched_null.procedure: random.Random(20260913), one fresh instance used only for the 60 matched-null draws, one sequential rng.sample(list, 69) per draw
matched_null.x_list_order: ascending integer order of the on-curve x-values of F_p

generic_relabelled_control.procedure: deterministic relabelling of the already-indexed height-box base into Z/nZ; no additional random draws

binding_limit: The density observable does not separate the height box from a matched negation-closed random base. These vectors are a fixture check, not a finding.
